title: Order processing rewrites the payment amount while a gateway capture is already running

bugs.note: Every order recalculation copies the order total and currency into the last open payment, and the remover drops cart-state payments when the total reaches zero, without asking whether a capture or authorize request for that payment is already in progress. If the cart changes (a promotion, a shipping change, a second tab) after the buyer was sent to the gateway, the payment record no longer matches what the gateway charges: the order is completed as paid for an amount that was never captured, or the payment the gateway is completing disappears.
